services.name: Punta Gorda Beach Tour
services.desc: Price $549 (up to 2 guests per flight) About Our Beach Tour begins and ends at Punta Gorda Airport. We start by heading almost due West over Rotonda towards Stump Pass. Continuing South down the beautiful Gulf Coast we fly low and slow along the beach, with views of Don Pedro Island, Little Gasparilla Island, and Boca Grande. From Boca Grande we fly over Useppa Island and Pine Island before returning to Punta Gorda Airport via Burnt Store Marina. Duration Please allow at least 75 minutes for your experience, to give adequate time for a safety briefing, and getting settled into the airplane. Beach tours last approximately 45-50 minutes, with a total flight time of approximately 40 minutes.

services.name: Punta Gorda Golden Hour Tour
services.desc: Price $649 (up to 2 guests per flight) About Golden Hour tours provide the smoothest, coolest air and magnificent sunrises and sunsets, casting golden hues over the water. Sunset flights leave approximately 45 minutes before sunset, giving us time to head Southwest across Charlotte Harbor to take in the views while still being back on the ground safely before darkness falls. There is a listed time for each day, but that may need to be adjusted depending on the actual sunset time for the day. Sunrise flights leave soon after dawn.
